concerns.text: US-2 scenario 2 requires 'the system identifies at least one specific eigenmode or curvature metric that shows a statistically significant correlation (p < 0.05)'. This pre-asserts a positive scientific finding as an acceptance condition, contradicting the spec's own Edge Case ('flag the hypothesis as unsupported and record the null result'). The idea asks to *identify which properties correlate* — the outcome may be null. Rephrase as 'the system outputs the correlation analysis with p-values', not a guaranteed significant hit.

FR-007's sensitivity sweep reports 'variation in false-positive/negative rates' — FP/FN rates are a classification metric with no defined meaning for a denoising/reconstruction task measured in Chamfer Distance. The idea contains no such metric. State the sweep outcome in terms of the actual metrics (Chamfer Distance / F-score variation across k and frequency threshold).
